title: M/S Bihariji Containers Pvt. Ltd. v. State of U.P.
coram: Dilip B. Bhosale, C.J.; Yashwant Varma, J.
disposition: Writ dismissed by adopting the even-date order in Writ-C No. 30898 of 2016.
headnote: A consumer's writ to quash a 24.05.2016 demand for additional security under clause 4.20 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005 was dismissed. On 15.07.2016 a Division Bench (Krishna Murari and Arvind Kumar Mishra-I, JJ.) had, without prejudice, stayed that demand and directed listing with Writ Petition (C) No. 51884 of 2009, following an interim order in a similar 2009 petition. The Chief Justice's Court later dismissed this petition by reference to the order of even date in Writ-C No. 30898 of 2016, without independent reasons here.
facts: M/S Bihariji Containers Pvt. Ltd. challenged a demand notice dated 24.05.2016 seeking additional security under Para 4.20 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005. On 15.07.2016 a Division Bench connected the petition with Writ Petition (C) No. 51884 of 2009 and, following an interim order dated 07.10.2009 in Writ Petition No. 51844 of 2009 (M/s Supreme Ceramics Limited), restrained the respondents from demanding additional security until further orders. On 21.03.2017 the Chief Justice's Court dismissed the writ.

holding_units.holding: The writ to quash a clause 4.20 additional-security demand was dismissed by adopting the order of even date in Writ-C No. 30898 of 2016. The 15.07.2016 order had, without prejudice, only restrained the licensee from demanding additional security pending disposal and directed listing with a connected 2009 petition.
